note: Anonymous GET of a password-protected video without the x-peertube-video-password header. Shape from PeerTube develop: server/core/middlewares/validators/shared/videos.ts checkCanSeePasswordProtectedVideo -> authenticateOrFail (401, ServerErrorCode.VIDEO_REQUIRES_PASSWORD) and middlewares/error.ts res.fail (ProblemDocument: type = docs URL + #section/Errors/<code>, code = <code>, detail = message). Anonymous gets 401, not 403; an authenticated user without rights gets 403.

body.detail: Please provide a password to access this password protected video
